description: Provision a Google Cloud Sql SQLSSLCert via Config Connector. Fields mirror the sql.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 SQLSSLCert spec.

commonName.description: Immutable. The common name to be used in the certificate to identify the client. Constrained to [a-zA-Z.-_ ]+. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

instanceRef.description: The Cloud SQL instance. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: Allowed value: The `name` field of a `SQLInstance` resource.

name.description: Name of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/names/#names

namespace.description: Namespace of the referent. More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The service-generated sha1Fingerprint of the resource. Used for acquisition only. Leave unset to create a new resource.

title: GCP Sql SQLSSLCert
